opening.argument: The video profiles Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses in Iowa through participants' accounts of what they learned and how their businesses developed. One describes attending classes and doing homework; another describes instruction on cash flow and broader business operations. Participants report becoming more strategic about expansion and creating four positions while expanding to two cities. Those are accounts of participant experience and outcomes, not a solicitation to viewers. The business and workshop visuals fit that educational profile. The reported growth does not establish that every participant achieved similar results, but it does show what the speakers say followed their participation.

citations.quote: Going there and sitting in those classes and doing that homework.
From cash flow to programs, they touched on your whole self. You really get in depth into the business.
We're just more strategic now about how we go and expand.
We've created four new positions. We've already expanded to two new cities.
